book.title: Being a Green Mother (Incarnations of Immortality, #5)
book.description: Orb plays magic in her harp, but seeks Llano, the song that controls Life. Natasha is handsome, charming, teaches her more spell tunes, but is he Satan? Her mother Niobe, Fate, warns of a prophecy she will marry Satan, and offers her the job of Nature. Author's Note 12-pg, bio 1-pg.
